name: Day 14 — 颱風要來了 Typhoon Inbound

readings.title: 颱風要來了 The Typhoon Is Coming

qs.q: What did they buy for the typhoon?
Where is the flashlight?
What did they do at night?
ch: Turned off the lights and slept early

gram.d: 要 + verb + 了 flags the imminent future: 颱風要來了 the typhoon's almost here, 我要出門了 I'm heading out, 電影要開始了 the movie's about to start. The 了 isn't past tense — it marks the situation changing right now.

readings.title: 有沒有颱風假？ Typhoon Day Off?

qs.q: What is everyone waiting for?
What happened at 8 PM?
ch: Work and school were canceled for tomorrow

qs.q: Why is the narrator worried?
ch: If the power goes out, nothing can be done

gram.d: 如果 opens the condition; the result clause usually carries 就 or 都: 如果停電，什麼都不能做 if the power dies, nothing works at all. Spoken Taiwan often drops to bare 「停電的話…」 — 的話 is the casual 如果.

readings.title: 故事①：颱風夜的麵店 Story ①: The Noodle Shop on Typhoon Night

qs.q: Why did the narrator run into the noodle shop?
Why was he startled?
ch: The owner greeted him as if expecting him

qs.q: What did the owner say about payment?
ch: Next time — which the narrator has never agreed to

gram.t: 一邊…一邊… — doing two things at once
gram.d: Two simultaneous actions: 我一邊吃，一邊想 I ate while thinking. 他一邊開會，一邊回訊息 he replies to messages while in the meeting. Keep both verbs active — states like 高興 don't take 一邊.

qs.q: Why is the factory tour postponed?
ch: Typhoon Bailu is about to make landfall

qs.q: When is the new tour time?
What must each unit report by tomorrow noon?

gram.t: 由於…，…將… — formal cause and plan
gram.d: 由於 is the written 因為; 將 is the written 會/要. Together they build announcement prose: 由於颱風即將登陸，參觀將延期。 Every company email and government notice runs on this frame — swap in your cause and your change.

readings.title: 颱風白鹿襲台 Typhoon Bailu Hits Taiwan

qs.q: What did the weather bureau issue today?
What has already happened in parts of the south?
What do manufacturers say about a halt beyond two days?
ch: Q3 production capacity will be affected

gram.t: 受到…影響 — the news passive
gram.d: 受到 + noun + 影響 is how headlines say 'affected by': 產能將受到影響, 交通受到颱風影響. Extend the family: 受到歡迎 well received, 受到重視 taken seriously — the formal passive without 被.

dict.py: Bīngxiāng lǐ yǒu hěnduō shuǐ.
dict.en: There's a lot of water in the fridge.

dict.py: Shǒudiàntǒng zài zhuōzi xiàmiàn.
dict.en: The flashlight is under the table.

dict.py: Wǒmen mǎi le sān bāo pàomiàn.
dict.en: We bought three packs of instant noodles.

dict.py: Qǐng bǎ dēng guān le.
dict.en: Please turn off the lights.

dict.py: Làzhú zài nǎlǐ?
dict.en: Where are the candles?

pass.zh: 老公，我到家了。冰箱很滿，水也買了。可是我找不到手電筒，你回家的時候，去便利商店再買一個，好不好？

qs.q: What has the wife already done?
ch: Filled the fridge and bought water

qs.q: What does she ask him to buy?

dict.py: Míngtiān yǒu méiyǒu táifēng jià?
dict.en: Is tomorrow a typhoon day off?

dict.py: Tiānqì yùbào shuō wǎnshàng huì dào.
dict.en: The forecast says it arrives tonight.

dict.zh: 如果停電，就不能上網了。
dict.py: Rúguǒ tíngdiàn, jiù bùnéng shàngwǎng le.
dict.en: If the power goes out, there's no internet.

dict.zh: 大家都在等市政府的消息。
dict.py: Dàjiā dōu zài děng shìzhèngfǔ de xiāoxí.
dict.en: Everyone's waiting for the city government's announcement.

dict.py: Fēng yuè lái yuè dà le.
dict.en: The wind is getting stronger and stronger.

pass.zh: 欸，看到了嗎？八點的新聞說，台北明天停班停課！我要在家看一整天的電影。你家泡麵夠不夠？不夠的話現在快去買，晚一點店裡什麼都沒有了。

qs.q: What did the 8 PM news announce?
ch: Taipei's work and school are canceled tomorrow

qs.q: Why go buy instant noodles now?
ch: Later the stores will be empty

dict.zh: 巷子口已經開始淹水了。
dict.py: Xiàngzi kǒu yǐjīng kāishǐ yānshuǐ le.
dict.en: The alley entrance has already started to flood.

dict.py: Quán Tái míngtiān tíng bān tíng kè.
dict.en: All of Taiwan cancels work and school tomorrow.

dict.zh: 不要囤貨囤太多，夠用就好。
dict.py: Búyào túnhuò tún tài duō, gòu yòng jiù hǎo.
dict.en: Don't stockpile too much — enough to get by is fine.

dict.py: Fángtái zhǔnbèi zuòhǎo le ma?
dict.en: Are your typhoon preparations done?

dict.zh: 陽台上的東西記得收進來。
dict.py: Yángtái shàng de dōngxi jìdé shōu jìnlái.
dict.en: Remember to bring in what's on the balcony.

pass.zh: 各位住戶請注意：颱風今晚登陸，請大家做好防颱準備，樓下停車場可能淹水，車子請先開到高一點的地方。管理室有手電筒，需要的住戶可以來借。

qs.q: What is the warning about the parking garage?
ch: It may flood — move cars higher

qs.q: What can residents borrow from the management office?

dict.zh: 原訂的工廠參觀將延期。
dict.py: Yuándìng de gōngchǎng cānguān jiāng yánqí.
dict.en: The originally scheduled factory tour will be postponed.

dict.py: Shēngchǎnxiàn kěnéng tínggōng liǎng tiān.
dict.en: The production line may halt for two days.

dict.zh: 請確認交期是否受到影響。
dict.py: Qǐng quèrèn jiāoqí shìfǒu shòudào yǐngxiǎng.
dict.en: Please confirm whether the delivery schedule is affected.

dict.zh: 新的時間改為下週三上午。
dict.py: Xīn de shíjiān gǎi wéi xià zhōusān shàngwǔ.
dict.en: The new time is changed to next Wednesday morning.

dict.py: Qǐng yú míngtiān zhōngwǔ qián huíbào.
dict.en: Please report back before noon tomorrow.

pass.zh: 您好，我是王先生的助理。關於這週五的參觀，我們董事長完全理解，安全第一。他說下週三很好，另外他想順便看一下測試的情況，麻煩您這邊先安排，謝謝。

qs.q: How did the chairman react to the postponement?
What extra request did he make for Wednesday?
ch: To also see the testing situation

dict.zh: 氣象局發布陸上颱風警報。
dict.py: Qìxiàngjú fābù lùshàng táifēng jǐngbào.
dict.en: The weather bureau issued a land typhoon warning.

dict.py: Nánbù yǐ chuánchū zāiqíng.
dict.en: Disaster damage has been reported in the south.

dict.zh: 停工超過兩天，產能將受到影響。
dict.py: Tínggōng chāoguò liǎng tiān, chǎnnéng jiāng shòudào yǐngxiǎng.
dict.en: A halt beyond two days will affect production capacity.

dict.zh: 企業應把風險降到最低。
dict.py: Qìyè yīng bǎ fēngxiǎn jiàng dào zuìdī.
dict.en: Companies should reduce risk to the minimum.

dict.py: Duō chù dàolù yīn yānshuǐ fēngbì.
dict.en: Many roads are closed due to flooding.

pass.zh: 為您播報最新消息：颱風白鹿今晚登陸，中央氣象局提醒民眾避免外出。南部災情持續傳出，高雄部分工業區已宣布停工。業者估計，若復原順利，下週產能可恢復九成。

qs.q: What have some industrial zones in Kaohsiung announced?
If recovery goes smoothly, what do firms estimate for next week?
ch: Capacity back to about ninety percent

scenarios.intro: The typhoon lands tonight. Your job: find the flashlight, count the noodles, and pass the household readiness inspection.

them.zh: 颱風要來了，我們家的水夠不夠？
them.py: Táifēng yào lái le, wǒmen jiā de shuǐ gòu bú gòu?
them.en: The typhoon's coming — do we have enough water?

turns.task: Reassure her — the fridge is full of water.

ans.zh: 夠！冰箱裡有很多水。
ans.py: Gòu! Bīngxiāng lǐ yǒu hěnduō shuǐ.
ans.en: Plenty! There's lots of water in the fridge.

them.zh: 那手電筒呢？我找不到。
them.py: Nà shǒudiàntǒng ne? Wǒ zhǎo bú dào.
them.en: And the flashlight? I can't find it.

turns.task: Tell her it's under the table.

ans.zh: 手電筒在桌子下面。
ans.py: Shǒudiàntǒng zài zhuōzi xiàmiàn.
ans.en: The flashlight is under the table.

them.zh: 泡麵只有兩包，夠嗎？
them.py: Pàomiàn zhǐyǒu liǎng bāo, gòu ma?
them.en: We only have two packs of instant noodles — enough?

turns.task: Say it's not enough — you'll go buy more.

ans.zh: 不夠，我去買，再買蠟燭。
ans.py: Bú gòu, wǒ qù mǎi, zài mǎi làzhú.
ans.en: Not enough — I'll go buy more, and candles too.

them.zh: 晚上風很大，你會怕嗎？
them.py: Wǎnshàng fēng hěn dà, nǐ huì pà ma?
them.en: The wind will be strong tonight — will you be scared?

turns.task: Say no — you'll turn off the lights and sleep early together.

ans.zh: 不怕！我們把燈關了，早一點睡覺。
ans.py: Bú pà! Wǒmen bǎ dēng guān le, zǎo yìdiǎn shuìjiào.
ans.en: Nope! We'll turn off the lights and sleep early.

them.zh: 好！那明天在家吃什麼？
them.py: Hǎo! Nà míngtiān zài jiā chī shénme?
them.en: OK! So what do we eat at home tomorrow?

turns.task: Instant noodles, of course — hot and delicious.

ans.zh: 吃泡麵啊！熱熱的，很好吃。
ans.py: Chī pàomiàn a! Rè rè de, hěn hǎochī.
ans.en: Instant noodles, of course! Hot and tasty.

scenarios.intro: It's 7:58 PM. All of Taiwan is refreshing the same page. Xiao Chen has strong opinions about tomorrow.

them.zh: 欸，你覺得明天會不會放颱風假？
them.py: Éi, nǐ juéde míngtiān huì bú huì fàng táifēng jià?
them.en: Hey, think tomorrow will be a typhoon day off?

turns.task: You checked the forecast — the typhoon reaches Taipei tonight, so probably yes.

ans.zh: 我看了天氣預報，颱風晚上會到台北，應該會放。
ans.py: Wǒ kàn le tiānqì yùbào, táifēng wǎnshàng huì dào Táiběi, yīnggāi huì fàng.
ans.en: I checked the forecast — it hits Taipei tonight, so probably yes.

them.zh: 八點了！快看市政府的消息！
them.py: Bā diǎn le! Kuài kàn shìzhèngfǔ de xiāoxí!
them.en: It's eight! Quick, check the city's announcement!

turns.task: Read it out — tomorrow work and school are canceled!

ans.zh: 明天停班停課！真的放颱風假了！
ans.py: Míngtiān tíng bān tíng kè! Zhēn de fàng táifēng jià le!
ans.en: Work and school canceled tomorrow! It's really a typhoon day off!

them.zh: 太好了！我要看一整天的電影！你呢？
them.py: Tài hǎo le! Wǒ yào kàn yì zhěng tiān de diànyǐng! Nǐ ne?
them.en: Awesome! I'm watching movies all day! You?

turns.task: You're a bit worried — if the power goes out, nothing works.

ans.zh: 我有點擔心，如果停電，什麼都不能做。
ans.py: Wǒ yǒudiǎn dānxīn, rúguǒ tíngdiàn, shénme dōu bùnéng zuò.
ans.en: I'm a little worried — if the power goes out, nothing works.

them.zh: 放心啦！去年颱風也沒停電啊。
them.py: Fàngxīn la! Qùnián táifēng yě méi tíngdiàn a.
them.en: Relax! Last year's typhoon didn't knock out the power.

turns.task: Fine, but you'll still charge your phone and buy instant noodles first.

ans.zh: 好啦，可是我還是要先充電，再買幾包泡麵。
ans.py: Hǎo la, kěshì wǒ háishì yào xiān chōngdiàn, zài mǎi jǐ bāo pàomiàn.
ans.en: OK, but I'm still charging my phone and buying a few packs of noodles first.

them.zh: 哈哈，你準備得比氣象局還認真！
them.py: Hāhā, nǐ zhǔnbèi de bǐ qìxiàngjú hái rènzhēn!
them.en: Haha, you prep harder than the weather bureau!

turns.task: Laugh it off — better safe than sorry; tell him to stay home tomorrow.

ans.zh: 小心一點比較好啦！你明天乖乖在家，不要出門喔。
ans.py: Xiǎoxīn yìdiǎn bǐjiào hǎo la! Nǐ míngtiān guāiguāi zài jiā, búyào chūmén ō.
ans.en: Better safe than sorry! Stay home like a good boy tomorrow — don't go out.

scenarios.intro: Half the neighborhood had the same idea. The shelves are thinning fast, and the clerk has seen it all before.

them.zh: 歡迎光臨！泡麵區剩不多了喔，要買要快。
them.py: Huānyíng guānglín! Pàomiàn qū shèng bù duō le ō, yào mǎi yào kuài.
them.en: Welcome! The instant-noodle section is almost empty — grab it while you can.

turns.task: Ask if there's still bottled water.

ans.zh: 請問還有沒有瓶裝的水？
ans.py: Qǐngwèn hái yǒu méiyǒu píngzhuāng de shuǐ?
ans.en: Excuse me, is there still bottled water?

them.zh: 水在最後面，大瓶的剩三箱，晚一點就沒了。
them.py: Shuǐ zài zuì hòumiàn, dà píng de shèng sān xiāng, wǎn yìdiǎn jiù méi le.
them.en: Water's at the very back — three cases of the big bottles left, gone soon.

turns.task: You'll take one case — no need to stockpile too much.

ans.zh: 我拿一箱就好，不用囤貨囤太多。
ans.py: Wǒ ná yì xiāng jiù hǎo, búyòng túnhuò tún tài duō.
ans.en: I'll just take one case — no need to stockpile too much.

them.zh: 對啊，每次颱風大家都搶，結果吃不完。
them.py: Duì a, měi cì táifēng dàjiā dōu qiǎng, jiéguǒ chī bù wán.
them.en: Right? Every typhoon everyone panic-buys, then can't finish it.

turns.task: Ask whether the street outside floods in heavy rain.

ans.zh: 請問外面那條路，雨大的時候會不會淹水？
ans.py: Qǐngwèn wàimiàn nà tiáo lù, yǔ dà de shíhòu huì bú huì yānshuǐ?
ans.en: Does the street outside flood when the rain gets heavy?

them.zh: 巷子口會，店門口還好。你住這附近嗎？
them.py: Xiàngzi kǒu huì, diàn ménkǒu hái hǎo. Nǐ zhù zhè fùjìn ma?
them.en: The alley entrance does; our doorway is fine. You live nearby?

turns.task: Yes — and your building announced the parking garage may flood.

ans.zh: 對，我們大樓說停車場可能會淹水，車要先開走。
ans.py: Duì, wǒmen dàlóu shuō tíngchēchǎng kěnéng huì yānshuǐ, chē yào xiān kāi zǒu.
ans.en: Yeah — our building says the garage may flood, cars have to move out first.

them.zh: 辛苦了！明天全台停班停課，好好在家休息吧。
them.py: Xīnkǔ le! Míngtiān quán Tái tíng bān tíng kè, hǎohǎo zài jiā xiūxí ba.
them.en: What a day! All Taiwan's canceled tomorrow — rest up at home.

turns.task: Thank them — and tell them to be careful going home too; typhoon prep matters.

ans.zh: 謝謝！你下班回家也要小心，防颱準備要做好喔！
ans.py: Xièxiè! Nǐ xiàbān huíjiā yě yào xiǎoxīn, fángtái zhǔnbèi yào zuòhǎo ō!
ans.en: Thanks! Be careful heading home after your shift too — get your typhoon prep done!

scenarios.intro: The chairman's factory tour is set for Friday — the same day Bailu arrives. Move it gracefully, keep the goodwill, and mind the delivery schedule.

them.zh: 您好！聽說台北那邊天氣不太好？
them.py: Nín hǎo! Tīngshuō Táiběi nà biān tiānqì bú tài hǎo?
them.en: Hello! I hear the weather up in Taipei isn't great?

turns.task: Confirm — the typhoon makes landfall tonight, and Friday's factory tour needs to be postponed.

ans.zh: 是的，颱風今晚登陸，原訂週五的工廠參觀，恐怕要延期了。
ans.py: Shì de, táifēng jīnwǎn dēnglù, yuándìng zhōuwǔ de gōngchǎng cānguān, kǒngpà yào yánqí le.
ans.en: Yes — the typhoon lands tonight, so I'm afraid Friday's factory tour will have to be postponed.

them.zh: 沒問題，安全第一！董事長那邊我來說明。
them.py: Méi wèntí, ānquán dì yī! Dǒngshìzhǎng nà biān wǒ lái shuōmíng.
them.en: No problem — safety first! I'll explain to the chairman.

turns.task: Thank him and propose next Wednesday at 10 AM instead.

ans.zh: 謝謝您！新的時間，我們想改為下週三上午十點，方便嗎？
ans.py: Xièxiè nín! Xīn de shíjiān, wǒmen xiǎng gǎi wéi xià zhōusān shàngwǔ shí diǎn, fāngbiàn ma?
ans.en: Thank you! For the new time, we'd like next Wednesday at 10 AM — does that work?

them.zh: 下週三可以。董事長還想順便看無人機的測試，可以安排嗎？
them.py: Xià zhōusān kěyǐ. Dǒngshìzhǎng hái xiǎng shùnbiàn kàn wúrénjī de cèshì, kěyǐ ānpái ma?
them.en: Wednesday works. The chairman would also like to see the drone testing — can you arrange that?

turns.task: Of course — the production line and testing area are both on the tour route.

ans.zh: 當然可以，生產線跟測試區都在參觀的行程裡。
ans.py: Dāngrán kěyǐ, shēngchǎnxiàn gēn cèshì qū dōu zài cānguān de xíngchéng lǐ.
ans.en: Of course — the production line and testing area are both on the tour route.

them.zh: 太好了。對了，工廠停工的話，交期會不會受到影響？
them.py: Tài hǎo le. Duìle, gōngchǎng tínggōng dehuà, jiāoqí huì bú huì shòudào yǐngxiǎng?
them.en: Perfect. Oh — if the factory halts, will the delivery schedule be affected?

turns.task: Reassure him — even with a two-day halt, the schedule holds; you'll confirm and report back tomorrow.

ans.zh: 請放心，就算停工兩天，交期應該沒有問題，我明天確認之後馬上回報您。
ans.py: Qǐng fàngxīn, jiùsuàn tínggōng liǎng tiān, jiāoqí yīnggāi méiyǒu wèntí, wǒ míngtiān quèrèn zhīhòu mǎshàng huíbào nín.
ans.en: Rest assured — even with a two-day halt the schedule should hold; I'll confirm and report back to you tomorrow.

them.zh: 有你們這句話我就放心了。你們也要注意安全喔！
them.py: Yǒu nǐmen zhè jù huà wǒ jiù fàngxīn le. Nǐmen yě yào zhùyì ānquán ō!
them.en: That's reassuring to hear. You all stay safe up there too!

turns.task: Thank him warmly — wish the south safety as well, and see them next Wednesday.

ans.zh: 謝謝王先生！也祝南部平安，我們下週三見！
ans.py: Xièxiè Wáng xiānshēng! Yě zhù nánbù píng'ān, wǒmen xià zhōusān jiàn!
ans.en: Thank you, Mr. Wang! Wishing the south safety too — see you next Wednesday!

scenarios.intro: The boss wants numbers, not weather poetry: production impact, delivery risk, and what you've already done about it.

them.zh: 颱風的情況怎麼樣？對我們的影響大不大？
them.py: Táifēng de qíngkuàng zěnmeyàng? Duì wǒmen de yǐngxiǎng dà bú dà?
them.en: What's the typhoon situation? How big is the impact on us?

turns.task: Summarize: the weather bureau issued land warnings; the factory may halt one to two days.

ans.zh: 氣象局已經發布陸上警報，工廠可能停工一到兩天。
ans.py: Qìxiàngjú yǐjīng fābù lùshàng jǐngbào, gōngchǎng kěnéng tínggōng yí dào liǎng tiān.
ans.en: The weather bureau has issued land warnings; the factory may halt for one to two days.

them.zh: 停兩天的話，產能跟交期呢？
them.py: Tíng liǎng tiān dehuà, chǎnnéng gēn jiāoqí ne?
them.en: If it's two days — capacity and delivery schedule?

turns.task: Report: capacity takes a small hit but the buffer covers it; the delivery schedule is not affected.

ans.zh: 產能會受到一點影響，但是我們有預留時間，交期不會受到影響。
ans.py: Chǎnnéng huì shòudào yìdiǎn yǐngxiǎng, dànshì wǒmen yǒu yùliú shíjiān, jiāoqí bú huì shòudào yǐngxiǎng.
ans.en: Capacity takes a small hit, but we built in buffer time — the delivery schedule won't be affected.

them.zh: 南部的災情呢？王先生那邊還好嗎？
them.py: Nánbù de zāiqíng ne? Wáng xiānshēng nà biān hái hǎo ma?
them.en: And the damage in the south? Is Mr. Wang's side all right?

turns.task: Some areas report flooding, but Mr. Wang's company is fine; the chairman's tour moved to next Wednesday.

ans.zh: 南部部分地區有災情，不過王先生公司沒事，董事長的參觀改到下週三。
ans.py: Nánbù bùfèn dìqū yǒu zāiqíng, búguò Wáng xiānshēng gōngsī méishì, dǒngshìzhǎng de cānguān gǎi dào xià zhōusān.
ans.en: Parts of the south report damage, but Mr. Wang's company is fine — the chairman's tour moved to next Wednesday.

them.zh: 很好。這次的處理，客戶滿意嗎？
them.py: Hěn hǎo. Zhè cì de chǔlǐ, kèhù mǎnyì ma?
them.en: Good. Is the client satisfied with how we handled it?

turns.task: Yes — Mr. Wang said safety first; you promised to confirm the schedule and report back tomorrow.

ans.zh: 滿意，王先生說安全第一。我答應明天確認交期之後，馬上回報他們。
ans.py: Mǎnyì, Wáng xiānshēng shuō ānquán dì yī. Wǒ dāyìng míngtiān quèrèn jiāoqí zhīhòu, mǎshàng huíbào tāmen.
ans.en: Yes — Mr. Wang said safety first. I promised to confirm the schedule tomorrow and report back right away.

them.zh: 辛苦了。以後每次颱風，我們都用今天這個流程。
them.py: Xīnkǔ le. Yǐhòu měi cì táifēng, wǒmen dōu yòng jīntiān zhège liúchéng.
them.en: Well done. From now on, every typhoon, we use today's process.

turns.task: Agree — you'll write it up as a standard typhoon-response procedure to reduce risk to the minimum.

ans.zh: 好的，我會把它寫成標準的防颱流程，把風險降到最低。
ans.py: Hǎo de, wǒ huì bǎ tā xiě chéng biāozhǔn de fángtái liúchéng, bǎ fēngxiǎn jiàng dào zuìdī.
ans.en: Will do — I'll write it up as a standard typhoon-response procedure to reduce risk to the minimum.

x: 冰箱裡有很多水跟水果。
Bīngxiāng lǐ yǒu hěnduō shuǐ gēn shuǐguǒ.
There's lots of water and fruit in the fridge.
vocab.n: 冰 ice + 箱 box. 冷凍庫 = freezer compartment, 冰 alone also means 'to chill': 幫我冰起來.

x: 睡覺以前，請把燈關了。
Shuìjiào yǐqián, qǐng bǎ dēng guān le.
Please turn off the lights before bed.
vocab.n: 開燈 / 關燈 = lights on / off. 紅綠燈 traffic light, 燈會 lantern festival — small word, big family.

x: 停電的時候，手電筒最重要。
Tíngdiàn de shíhòu, shǒudiàntǒng zuì zhòngyào.
When the power's out, the flashlight matters most.
vocab.n: 手 hand + 電 electric + 筒 tube. Phone flashlight = 手機的手電筒 — same word.

x: 我們買了六根蠟燭。
Wǒmen mǎi le liù gēn làzhú.
We bought six candles.
vocab.n: Measure word 根 (stick-shaped). 吹蠟燭 = blow out birthday candles — same candles, happier occasion.

x: 颱風天，家家都在吃泡麵。
Táifēng tiān, jiājiā dōu zài chī pàomiàn.
On typhoon days, every household eats instant noodles.
vocab.n: 泡 to steep + 麵: Taiwan says 泡麵, the mainland 方便麵. 泡 alone: 泡茶 brew tea, 泡湯 soak in hot springs.

x: 明天放颱風假，不用上班！
Míngtiān fàng táifēng jià, búyòng shàngbān!
Tomorrow's a typhoon day off — no work!
vocab.n: 放假 pattern: 放颱風假, 放年假. Announced by each city around 8 PM — the most-refreshed webpage in Taiwan.

x: 天氣預報說颱風晚上會到。
Tiānqì yùbào shuō táifēng wǎnshàng huì dào.
The forecast says the typhoon arrives tonight.
vocab.n: 預 in advance + 報 report. Also 氣象預報 in newscasts — same thing, one register up.

x: 昨天晚上停電了兩個小時。
Zuótiān wǎnshàng tíngdiàn le liǎng ge xiǎoshí.
The power was out for two hours last night.
vocab.n: 停 + utility is a set: 停電, 停水 water outage, 停課 classes canceled. 跳電 = a tripped breaker — smaller drama.

x: 雨太大，巷子口都淹水了。
Yǔ tài dà, xiàngzi kǒu dōu yānshuǐ le.
The rain's too heavy — the alley entrance is flooded.
vocab.n: 淹 to submerge. News scale-up: 淹水警戒 flood alert, 積水 standing water (the milder cousin).

x: 台北市宣布明天停班停課。
Táiběi shì xuānbù míngtiān tíng bān tíng kè.
Taipei announced work and school are canceled tomorrow.
vocab.n: The official four-character verdict everyone waits for. Halfway options exist: 停課不停班 — kids win, adults lose.

x: 不用囤貨囤太多，夠用就好。
Búyòng túnhuò tún tài duō, gòu yòng jiù hǎo.
No need to stockpile too much — enough to get by is fine.
vocab.n: 囤 hoard + 貨 goods. Business sense too: retailers 囤貨 before price hikes. Panic-buying = 搶購.

x: 防颱準備做好了嗎？
Fángtái zhǔnbèi zuòhǎo le ma?
Are your typhoon preparations done?
vocab.n: 防 guard against + 颱: the productive 防-family — 防水 waterproof, 防災 disaster prevention, 防曬 sunscreen.

x: 下週三客戶要來參觀我們的工廠。
Xià zhōusān kèhù yào lái cānguān wǒmen de gōngchǎng.
The client tours our factory next Wednesday.
vocab.n: 廠 alone works in compounds: 廠商 vendor/manufacturer, 廠長 plant manager, 代工廠 contract manufacturer.

x: 這條生產線一天可以組十架無人機。
Zhè tiáo shēngchǎnxiàn yì tiān kěyǐ zǔ shí jià wúrénjī.
This production line can assemble ten drones a day.
vocab.n: Measure word 條. 生產 to produce + 線 line; 產線 for short in factory talk — how engineers actually say it.

x: 歡迎董事長來參觀測試區。
Huānyíng dǒngshìzhǎng lái cānguān cèshì qū.
We welcome the chairman to tour the testing area.
vocab.n: For places and facilities; visiting people is 拜訪. 參觀工廠 factory tour — a fixture of every business trip.

x: 就算停工兩天，交期也沒問題。
Jiùsuàn tínggōng liǎng tiān, jiāoqí yě méi wèntí.
Even with a two-day halt, the delivery date is fine.
vocab.n: 交 hand over + 期 date. The word every supplier email orbits: 趕交期 rushing to meet delivery, 交期延誤 delivery delay.

x: 氣象局發布了陸上颱風警報。
Qìxiàngjú fābù le lùshàng táifēng jǐngbào.
The weather bureau issued a land typhoon warning.
vocab.n: Full name 中央氣象署 (renamed 2023), but 氣象局 survives in speech. 局/署 = government agency suffixes.

x: 南部已經傳出災情。
Nánbù yǐjīng chuánchū zāiqíng.
Disaster damage has been reported in the south.
vocab.n: 災 disaster + 情 situation: 傳出災情 damage reported, 災情慘重 severe damage — typhoon-news boilerplate.

x: 停工兩天，第三季產能會受到影響。
Tínggōng liǎng tiān, dì sān jì chǎnnéng huì shòudào yǐngxiǎng.
A two-day halt will affect Q3 production capacity.
vocab.n: 產 output + 能 capacity: 產能滿載 at full capacity, 擴大產能 expand capacity — semiconductor-news vocabulary you'll see weekly.

x: 高雄部分工業區宣布停工。
Gāoxióng bùfèn gōngyèqū xuānbù tínggōng.
Some Kaohsiung industrial zones announced work stoppages.
vocab.n: Sibling of 停班 (office) — 停工 is the factory floor. Opposite: 復工 resume work, the headline that follows every typhoon.

x: 颱風那個風聲，聽了讓人皮皮挫。
Táifēng nàge fēngshēng, tīng le ràng rén pípícuò.
That typhoon wind sound makes you shake in your boots.
slang.n: Hokkien onomatopoeia for shivering. Written 皮皮挫, read pípícuò in Mandarin mouths — fear, cold, or pre-presentation nerves.

x: 報告還沒改完就颱風假結束，我現在挫咧等。
Bàogào hái méi gǎi wán jiù táifēng jià jiéshù, wǒ xiànzài cuòlièděng.
Typhoon break's over and the report isn't done — now I'm sweating it out.
slang.n: Hokkien: 挫 tremble + 咧 -ing + 等 wait. Dreading what's coming and unable to do anything but wait. Same 挫 as 皮皮挫.

x: 外面風雨這麼大，他還很淡定地泡茶。
Wàimiàn fēngyǔ zhème dà, tā hái hěn dàndìng de pào chá.
Storm raging outside, and he's calmly brewing tea.
slang.n: Mainland-viral (the 淡定紅茶 meme), long since naturalized in Taiwan. The composure compliment — or sarcastic for someone TOO calm.

slang.e: gone off the rails, warped out of shape (Hokkien)
x: 颱風假睡到下午三點，作息完全走鐘。
Táifēng jià shuì dào xiàwǔ sān diǎn, zuòxí wánquán zǒuzhōng.
Slept till 3 PM on the typhoon day — my schedule's completely off the rails.
slang.n: Hokkien 'the clock has walked': anything drifted from its proper state — schedules, diets, celebrity faces (外貌走鐘 is tabloid-speak).

slang.e: scared out of one's mind (TW youth)
x: 半夜窗戶突然砰一聲，我整個嚇爛。
Bànyè chuānghù túrán pēng yì shēng, wǒ zhěngge xiàlàn.
The window banged in the middle of the night — I was scared witless.
slang.n: 嚇 scare + 爛 to bits: the 爛-as-intensifier pattern (笑爛 laughing to death). PTT/Dcard register — for friends, not the 董事長.
